description: Risk-preference matrix cell (2, 2) of 6x6: seat 1 = Eckel-Grossman gamble 2 of 6, seat 2 = gamble 2 of 6 (paper SI Task 1, arXiv-2607.26034v1). Each seat's risk level is drawn independently, since risk preference is a per-participant attribute, not a race-level constant; the diagonal (i == j) is the symmetric case.
